cases.description: A complete contract advances without implying implementation.
Recorded failing reproduction is checked by the real rule.
Passing reproduction must not authorise speculative coding.
An expired lease without handoff becomes reclaimable; this is not a dispatch.
Complete simulated validation must reach the fake merge and return.
An architecture rejection stops the simulated merge.
A provenance base not ancestral to the candidate is rejected.
A failed post-merge verification is not successful completion.
